name: WayriCAD Quick PI
description: DC power-integrity simulation with default 2.5D and optional Gmsh 3D copper-volume models.
description_full: Solve DC voltage drop, current density and Joule loss on saved traces, pads, filled zones and plated via barrels. The default 2.5D model and an optional Gmsh tetrahedral 3D copper-volume model have native result views and export field evidence. KiCad 10 native Python with NumPy, SciPy, VTK and Matplotlib is required; the 3D mode additionally needs Gmsh. This is a screening model, not a full-wave AC or coupled electrothermal solver.
